title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion — PostgreSQL
symptom: Application logs show 'too many connections'; pg_stat_activity shows max_connections saturated; latency spikes across all DB-dependent services.
recommended_action: systemctl restart pgbouncer && kubectl rollout restart deployment/<db-client-service>
remediation_steps: Check active connections: psql -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity;'
Identify top connection holders: psql -c 'SELECT usename, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY usename ORDER BY count DESC;'
Terminate idle connections: psql -c 'SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = \'idle\' AND query_start < now() - interval \'5 min\';'
Scale connection pooler: kubectl scale deployment/pgbouncer --replicas=3
